answer: At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a juniper tag. The cedar cap is enforced at intake and pearl shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a swarm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
